context:
Goal: A native pass record means the native code works.
Problem (risk): CLAUDE.md says native-check is the full Swift suite, once per batch. The target builds the UI test bundle (80 files) but never runs it, so a pass proves less than it says. The cost of running it on the shared simulator Mac is unmeasured.
Based on (read): degen CLAUDE.md:39; Makefile:130-135 runs swift test and two build-for-testing steps; native/project.yml:115 defines DegenUITests (main e9d14f5).
Based on (notes): Cost of the UI bundle on the shared simulator Mac: unmeasured.
Departs from: native-check builds the UI tests and never runs them — it runs DegenUITests once per batch, after one timed run prices it.

lastAnswer.note: Filed in degen CLAUDE.md rule tests-once-per-batch, draft PR https://github.com/shivinate7/degen/pull/422 (Makefile change: follow-up lane native-check-ui-tests); closes when it merges.

options.gain: A pass means the UI works too.
options.how: Add a test action for the UI bundle to native-check, after one timed run.
options.label: Run the UI tests
options.lose: A longer batch gate on the shared Mac.

options.how: Reword CLAUDE.md:39 and native.md to say UI tests are built, not run.
options.label: Reword to build-only
options.lose: The UI goes unchecked at the gate.
